a2-13-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Gloves
a2-13-01.scenario: After the volunteer day in the park in Hanoi, Lucía is writing a message to her family and asks you when the group received the gloves. You received them when you arrived at the park.
a2-13-01.prompt: Tell Lucía that you received the gloves when you arrived at the park.
a2-13-01.target: Recibimos los guantes cuando llegamos al parque.
a2-13-01.english: We received the gloves when we arrived at the park.
a2-13-01.canDo: I can say when a completed past action happened using cuando and the pretérito indefinido.

a2-13-02.title: Communicative Challenge: While We Worked
a2-13-02.scenario: Daniela is writing captions for the photos of the volunteer day in the park in Hanoi and asks what you did while you collected rubbish. You spoke with the volunteers.
a2-13-02.prompt: Tell Daniela that you spoke with the volunteers while you collected rubbish.
cues: Say what else you did at the same time
a2-13-02.target: Mientras recogimos basura, hablamos con los voluntarios.
a2-13-02.english: While we collected rubbish, we spoke with the volunteers.
a2-13-02.canDo: I can connect simultaneous past actions using mientras.

a2-13-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Cuando or Mientras
a2-13-03.scenario: Lucía arrived late to the park in Hanoi and asks what happened before she came. When you arrived at the neighbourhood you cleaned the park, and you spoke with other people while you worked.
a2-13-03.prompt: Tell Lucía what you did when you arrived and what you did while you worked.
cues: Say what you did when you arrived
Say what you did while you worked
a2-13-03.target: Cuando llegamos al barrio, limpiamos el parque. Mientras trabajamos, hablamos con otras personas.
a2-13-03.english: When we arrived at the neighbourhood, we cleaned the park. While we worked, we spoke with other people.
a2-13-03.canDo: I can choose cuando or mientras when describing past events.

a2-13-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Day of Volunteering
a2-13-04.scenario: Carlos is making a photo album of the volunteer day at the park in Hanoi and asks you to tell the day in order. You received the gloves when you arrived, you collected rubbish while you worked, and afterwards you cleaned the park.
a2-13-04.prompt: Tell Carlos about the day in order: what happened when you arrived, while you worked, and afterwards.
cues: Say what you received when you arrived
Say what you did while you worked
a2-13-04.target: Cuando llegamos, recibimos los guantes. Mientras trabajamos, recogimos basura. Después limpiamos el parque.
a2-13-04.english: When we arrived, we received the gloves. While we worked, we collected rubbish. Afterwards we cleaned the park.
a2-13-04.canDo: I can connect and sequence events during a day of volunteering.

a2-13-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Our Volunteer Day
a2-13-05.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Lucía wants to write about the volunteer day and asks you to tell the story of the day. You received the gloves when you arrived, you planted flowers while you worked, and you went home when the activity ended.
a2-13-05.prompt: Tell Lucía the story of the volunteer day with cuando and mientras.
cues: Say what happened when you arrived
Say what you did while you worked
Say what you did when the activity ended
a2-13-05.target: Cuando llegamos, recibimos los guantes. Mientras trabajamos, plantamos flores. Cuando terminó la actividad, volvimos a casa.
a2-13-05.english: When we arrived, we received the gloves. While we worked, we planted flowers. When the activity ended, we went home.
a2-13-05.canDo: I can recount a day as volunteers using cuando, mientras and the pretérito indefinido.

a2-13-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Activity
a2-13-consolidation.scenario: Meg is writing a message for the language exchange group chat about the volunteer day at the park in Hanoi and asks what you did. The activity ended and you went home, and while you collected rubbish you spoke with other people.
a2-13-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you did when the activity ended and what you did while you collected rubbish.
cues: Say what you did when the activity ended
Say what you did while you collected rubbish
a2-13-consolidation.target: Cuando terminó la actividad, volvimos a casa. Mientras recogimos basura, hablamos con otras personas.
a2-13-consolidation.english: When the activity ended, we went home. While we collected rubbish, we spoke with other people.
a2-13-consolidation.canDo: I can use cuando and mientras with the pretérito indefinido.
